title: UGC Ads for New York City Brands
metaTitle: UGC Ads for New York City Brands | TDM
metaDescription: UGC ads for New York City brands: hook-first scripts, filmed by TDM's own US-based creators, edited into batches of variations and iterated on ad data.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) scripts, produces and edits UGC ads for New York City brands. These are creator-style videos, filmed handheld and spoken to camera, made to run as paid ads on Meta and TikTok. The videos are filmed in the United States by TDM's own US-based creators, and the footage is edited at our operations office in Lahore. You approve scripts and creators, and receive batches of ad variations ready to test.

sections.heading: Why creator-style ads suit New York brands
paragraphs: A large share of American direct-to-consumer brands began in offices and apartments here, in beauty, skincare, fashion, food and drink, home goods and wellness. They compete for the same feeds, and their customers have become skilled at spotting an advertisement and scrolling on. A polished brand film signals that an ad has started. A person holding the product and explaining what surprised them about it does not, at least for the first few seconds, and those seconds decide whether the rest is watched.

New York shoppers are also sceptical by habit. They have many alternatives and have seen most claims before. The scripts that work with a sceptical audience name the doubt directly: a problem called out plainly, an unboxing that shows what really arrives, a before and after, or a doubter who was won over.

sections.heading: What the service includes
paragraphs: Each batch starts with research. We read your reviews, customer questions and past ad results to find the objections and desires worth turning into hooks. Scripts and creators are approved by you before anything is filmed.
bullets: Hook-first scripts, with several openings written for every concept.
On-camera creators from TDM's own US-based team, briefed and directed to match your customer profile.
Handheld, native-looking footage, not studio polish.
Editing with jump cuts, captions and pacing suited to Meta and TikTok feeds.
Delivery in batches of variations with different hooks, lengths and calls to action.
Scripts checked against platform advertising policies for your category before filming.

sections.heading: How filming and editing are divided
paragraphs: UGC ads rarely depend on a landmark. The setting is a bathroom shelf, a kitchen counter, a desk or a sofa, and the subject is the product in someone's hands. Our creators are TDM's own people in the United States, so the homes, voices and habits on screen are ones your customers recognise. They film to the approved scripts, and the raw takes go to our editors in Lahore, who cut each session into variations. If an ad truly needs a recognisable city backdrop, we will say so and plan it as a location shoot with the same team.

The loop after delivery matters as much as the filming. Where TDM manages the ad account, we read hook rate, hold rate and cost per acquisition for each video and write the next batch from what those numbers showed. Where another team buys your media, we work from shared reports.

sections.heading: What to confirm before commissioning UGC
paragraphs: Check who owns the finished ads and for how long you may run them as paid media. Ask how many distinct hooks you will get, since an account with one or two videos cannot test anything. Make sure paid endorsements are disclosed as advertising rules require, and that claims about health, skin or money can be supported. Ask who decides what the following batch contains, and on what evidence.

presence: TDM has no office or studio in New York City. UGC ads for New York brands are filmed in the United States by our own US-based creators and edited at our operations office in Lahore, with scripts, creators and cuts approved online.

faqs.q: Who appears in the UGC ads you make for New York brands?
faqs.a: TDM's own US-based creators, matched to your customer profile. They film in the United States, and you approve the creators and scripts before any filming begins.

faqs.q: How much do UGC ads cost for a New York brand?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: the number of concepts, the variations per concept and the creators involved. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How many videos come in a batch?
faqs.a: Batches are sized for testing, with several concepts and more than one hook for each, plus different lengths and endings. The exact count is set in the plan.

faqs.q: How long does a batch of UGC ads take to produce?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief, how quickly scripts are approved and how many concepts are being filmed. The schedule is agreed in the plan.

faqs.q: Do I need TDM to run my ads as well?
faqs.a: No. If another team manages your campaigns, we iterate from the performance reports you share. When we run the account ourselves, we read the results directly and plan the following batch from them.
